_comment: EV.4 proof: a genuinely useful verb that exists ONLY as content. Two steps, two applets, read then write — composed from registered capabilities, with no Swift case anywhere.
summary: Save the page the user is looking at as an AI Write document.

title.summary: Document title. Defaults to the page's own title.

notes: Reads whichever surface the user is watching — the Workbench preview counts. The document is a snapshot, not a live link; re-run it to refresh. NOT Shortcut-safe (appIntent:false): it writes, and it captures whatever page happens to be open. A person invoking it is deciding; an automation firing at 3am against a page left on screen is not. Reachable from the portal, not from Shortcuts.
